title: BattINFO Material Spec
description: Reusable specification of a battery material (e.g. graphite, LFP, NMC811, PVDF, carbon black). The 'spec' half of the spec+instance pair; a material instance is a physical lot/batch realizing this spec.

schema_version.description: Version of the record schema this document conforms to (semantic versioning); stamped by the library on save.

kind.description: Required Level-1 MaterialKind key from the curated material_kinds vocabulary (e.g. 'graphite', 'lfp', 'nmc811'). The aggregation axis of the Battery Genome; resolves to the kind's chemical-substance class IRI. An unknown kind is rejected at save time. See battinfo.materials.material_kind_keys().

grade.description: Manufacturer grade / product version (e.g. 'grade X', 'v2'). Part of spec identity together with manufacturer and product.

material_class.description: Deprecated in favor of the kind’s roles (the curated vocabulary lists the use-site slots a kind is known to fill): a single forced role is system-relative. Accepted for back-compat and still written by importers; slated for removal at the next record-shape version.

electrode_polarity.description: Deprecated, do not author: polarity is an electrode property, never a material’s — state it on the electrode or through the cell’s holders. Accepted only so existing records keep validating.

emmo_type.description: Optional EMMO/domain-battery class label or IRI for this material; informs JSON-LD @type.

supplier.description: Supplier or vendor the item was sourced from.

product_id.description: Manufacturer / supplier product or grade identifier.

composition.description: Structured derivation of this grade: base material, coatings, dopants, and constituents.

property.description: Named quantity map of technical properties (snake_case key to value+unit quantity).

description.description: Longer free-text description of the material.

source_type.description: Kind of source this record was created from.

source_name.description: Human-readable name of the source (document title, instrument, lab, or system).

source_file.description: Filename or path of the source file, when the record was derived from a file.

source_url.description: URL of the source document or landing page, when available.

citation.description: Resolvable citation target to use for attribution, typically a DOI URL.

citation_doi.description: DOI of the source publication (bare '10.xxxx/...' form). Prefer provenance.citation with a DOI resolver URL.

retrieved_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch, UTC) when the source was retrieved or the record was captured.

file_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the source file, for integrity verification.

workflow_version.description: Version of the ingest/curation workflow that produced this record.

curated_by.description: Name or identifier of the person who curated this record.

battinfo_version.description: Version of the battinfo library that wrote this record (semantic versioning); stamped on save.

provenance.description: Where the information in this record came from: source type, file or URL, citation, and retrieval time.

notes.description: Free-text notes carried with the record.

contributor.description: People who contributed this record to the platform (attribution/provenance). Each is a schema:Person; an ORCID may be given in same_as. Stamped by ws.save.

license.description: License under which this record is released, as an SPDX identifier (e.g. "cc-by-4.0") or a URL. Stamped from the workspace default (ws.license) and emitted as dcterms:license in JSON-LD.

UnixTime.description: Unix timestamp in whole seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

ShortId.description: Short human-friendly identifier derived from the record IRI (Crockford base32, 6-16 characters).

OrganizationIri.description: Canonical BattINFO IRI in the organization/ namespace (https://w3id.org/battinfo/organization/xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx).

id.description: Canonical BattINFO organization IRI linking this party to its organization record.

Organization.description: An organization referenced by name, with an optional canonical BattINFO organization IRI.

OrgRef.description: An organization, as either a plain name string or a structured Organization object that can carry a canonical organization IRI.

Funding.description: Funding project (grant) under which the record was produced. Maps to schema:funding / schema:Grant in JSON-LD.

MaterialRef.description: Reference to another material by canonical material-spec IRI and/or a free-text name.

material_spec_id.description: IRI of the material-spec record being referenced.

name.description: Free-text material name, used when no material-spec record exists.

property.description: Quantities qualifying the reference (e.g. mass_fraction, thickness).

Composition.description: Structured composition for derived/blended materials: a base material with surface coatings, dopants, and/or constituent fractions.

base_material_id.description: Parent/base material this grade derives from (e.g. base NMC811 for an Al2O3-coated grade).

coatings.description: Surface coating layers (e.g. Al2O3), each optionally carrying its own properties (thickness, mass_fraction).

element.description: Chemical symbol of the dopant element (e.g. 'Al', 'Zr').

fraction.description: Dopant fraction. Use unit 'mol/mol' for a mole fraction, or unit '1' (0-1) or '%' (0-100) for a mass fraction.

dopants.description: Dopant elements with their fractions (mole fraction with unit 'mol/mol', or mass fraction with unit '1' or '%').

constituents.description: Constituent materials of a blend/mixture, each with its mass_fraction (unit '1' or '%') under its property map.
